sample.title: Why It's So Expensive To Run An Auto Repair Shop
sample.description:
Auto repair prices have risen far faster than overall inflation. Mechanics say one key reason is the new software, parts, and safety technology. Shops are spending more on software access and safety calibration equipment. While the number of auto repair shops has grown, some who work in the business say it is getting harder to keep up, especially for smaller ones.

LIVE: Christa Pike's lawyers in court after failed execution of US death row inmate | BBC News
sample.description:
Lawyers for US death row inmate Christa Pike are in court today asking a judge to order Tennessee to preserve all evidence from her botched execution last week. 

The emergency motion filed by her legal team could lay the groundwork for a future lawsuit against the state over how the failed execution was carried out. 

Pike's lawyers say she is now "conscious and speaking" after surviving two lethal doses of the drug pentobarbital - her lawyer says she continues to receive care while handcuffed in hospital. 

Pike was sentenced to death following her conviction for murdering Colleen Slemmer in 1995.
